first_breath.name: First Breath
first_breath.lore: Atop the cliff-temple, a thin figure breathes in time with the wind. "You wish to step on air? First — prove you can survive on it."

steps.label: Find Wind Master Reva at the cliff-temple
steps.hint: She answers only to the breath she taught you.

steps.label: Survive 3 wild battles after meeting her

Reva.phrase: The wind remembers what was promised.

first_breath.completedFlavor: Reva nods slowly. "You moved when the wind moved. That is the first step." Wind Step is yours.

first_dawn.name: First Dawn
first_dawn.lore: In the Sanctuary's open courtyard, Iyra waits at dawn. "To walk the sun's path, you must first burn brightly enough to be seen by it."

steps.label: Find Sun Priestess Iyra in the dawn courtyard
steps.hint: She speaks only to those who can name the sun's first hour.

steps.label: Win 5 wild battles after she sees you

Iyra.phrase: I came in time for the burning.

first_dawn.completedFlavor: Iyra closes her eyes. "The sun has marked you." Sun Walk is yours.

tides_of_sanctuary.name: Tides of Sanctuary
tides_of_sanctuary.lore: By the Sanctuary's reflecting pool, Solen watches the water rise and fall. "Harmony is not the absence of force. It is force that knows when to yield."

steps.label: Find Tide-Keeper Solen at the reflecting pool
steps.hint: He recognizes only the hand that has learned to fold.

steps.label: Win 6 wild battles after he sees you

tides_of_sanctuary.completedFlavor: Solen touches the pool. The ripples follow you out. Tide Veil is yours.

oath_of_iron.name: Oath of Iron
oath_of_iron.lore: Vance does not look up from the whetstone. "The Order does not teach. It tests. Bring me proof you can stand."

steps.label: Find Hierarch Vance in the iron yard
steps.hint: He answers only to a phrase that costs the speaker something.

steps.label: Win 7 wild battles after Vance accepts you

Vance.phrase: I am the blade, not the hand.

oath_of_iron.completedFlavor: Vance hands you the whetstone. "The Order recognizes you." Bone Crush is yours.

void_initiation.name: Void Initiation
void_initiation.lore: Kael speaks without moving his mouth. "The Rift gives. It also takes. Are you prepared to lose pieces of yourself?"

steps.label: Find Rift-Tongue Kael past the rift gate
steps.hint: He answers to a name he never gave.

steps.label: Win 8 wild battles after Kael accepts you

Kael.phrase: I have not come to ask.

void_initiation.completedFlavor: Kael smiles — somewhere behind his face. "Now you can cut." Void Sever is yours.

broken_communion.name: Broken Communion
broken_communion.lore: "You've felt the corruption in your shards," Kael whispers. "Bring me four more bound by chain. Prove you can carry the noise."
broken_communion.completedFlavor: Kael nods. The shards in your vault hum more loudly now. You feel the Rift watching back.

rite_of_embers.name: Rite of Embers
rite_of_embers.lore: Phlox kneels at a low brazier in a stone garden. The coal does not seem to need fuel. "Tongue and fire are the same teacher," she says. "Come closer."

steps.label: Find Speaker Phlox at the stone-garden brazier
steps.hint: She replies only to a word the speaker can feel in the throat.

steps.label: Win 5 wild battles after she accepts you

Phlox.phrase: The fire is already in my mouth.

rite_of_embers.completedFlavor: Phlox tilts her head once. The coal flares brighter. Pyrolexis is yours.

vow_of_the_shield.name: Vow of the Shield
vow_of_the_shield.lore: Aspis stands in the lower colonnade where the Sanctuary meets the road. He carries a shield he has never set down. "Defense is not retreat," he says without looking up. "Defense is the place you will not let pass."

steps.label: Find Aspis the Quiet in the lower colonnade
steps.hint: Recognized only by those who name what they would die to keep behind them.

steps.label: Win 6 wild battles after his vigil accepts you

Aspis.phrase: I will not let it pass.

vow_of_the_shield.completedFlavor: Aspis lifts the shield by a hand's breadth and lowers it again. The vow is taken. Kataphraxis is yours.

covenant_of_caligo.name: Covenant of Caligo
covenant_of_caligo.lore: There is a stretch of road that is colder than the rest. No one waits there during the day. At dusk, a thin figure named Caligo stands at its center. "You wish to wear shadow," he says. "You must first be willing to be one."

steps.label: Find Caligo on the cold stretch of road at dusk
steps.hint: He answers only when the speaker accepts being unseen.

steps.label: Win 10 wild battles in the dark after he covenants with you

covenant_of_caligo.completedFlavor: Caligo nods, and the road forgets him. He does not look back at you. Tenebris is yours.

starlit_passage.name: Starlit Passage
starlit_passage.lore: Past the city wall, on a hill where the grass grows in slow circles, a woman called Selene walks the same loop nightly. "The stars do not strike," she says. "They arrive. There is a difference."

steps.label: Find Selene on the circular hill after sundown
steps.hint: She replies only to those who have stopped trying to catch up with her.

steps.label: Win 10 wild battles after she walks beside you once

starlit_passage.completedFlavor: Selene continues her loop. After a step, you realize she has folded a piece of the night into your hand. Astrobolos is yours.

the_mercy_rising.name: The Mercy Rising
the_mercy_rising.lore: An old woman called Eleos sits in a garden the Sanctuary will not name. She tends plants that have already died, watering them anyway. "You wish to rise," she says. "To rise, you must first agree to be spent."

steps.label: Find Eleos in the unnamed garden
steps.hint: She greets only the bearer who is ready to give themselves.

steps.label: Win 12 wild battles after her blessing

the_mercy_rising.completedFlavor: Eleos closes her eyes. The dead plants stir, just once, as if remembering. Anastasis is yours.

the_first_keeper.name: The First Keeper
the_first_keeper.lore: The scroll names no giver. Just three figures and three trials: a Reader by the cliff, a Smith in the iron yard, a Veiled One past the rift gate. Walk all three. Speak the words none of them taught you out loud.

steps.label: Find Wind Master Reva at the cliff-temple
steps.hint: Hidden command will be DM'd when you accept.

steps.label: Find Hierarch Vance in the iron yard
steps.hint: Speak the right word at the right place.

steps.label: Find Rift-Tongue Kael past the rift gate
steps.hint: He answers to a name he never gave.

steps.label: Survive 5 wild battles after meeting all three

Reva.phrase: The wind remembers what was promised.

Vance.phrase: I am the blade, not the hand.

Kael.phrase: I have not come to ask.

the_first_keeper.completedFlavor: The three figures meet you on a road that wasn't there yesterday. They say nothing. The scroll dissolves. You feel — older.
